## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper strategy's exit parameters (stop loss, take profit, time stop, chandelier arm) and volatility filter can be tuned to improve edge capture on J's anchor days while reducing losses on loser days. The specific combination of tighter stop (-35% premium), higher TP (75% premium), shorter time stop (12 min), wider strike offset (2), moderate chandelier arm (60%), and vol ratio threshold (1.2) aims to balance winner capture and loser mitigation.

## Mechanism

Enter on shotgun_scalper signals (volume-triggered breakouts with EMA alignment). Exit logic: 
- Stop loss: -35% of entry premium (catastrophe cap) 
- Take profit: +75% of entry premium at 66.7% quantity 
- Time stop: 12 minutes 
- Strike selection: ATM + 2 strikes offset 
- Chandelier profit-lock: arms at +60% favor, trails 15% off HWM 
- Volatility filter: only trade when current volume > 1.2x 20-bar average volume
